sections.heading: Summary
paragraphs: Per the file, increase the per acct CU limit from a (per the file) static 12M to 40% (per the file) of the block CU limit. Those statements are the file’s claims, not a Sol.College measurement of a live cluster.

Per the file, max Writable Account Units (per the file) - The maximum number of CUs that may be used to write any given acct in a block. Per the file, max Vote Units - The (per the file) maximum number of CUs that may be used by simple (per the file) votes in a block. Per the file, max Block Accounts Data (per the file) Size Delta - The maximum size of the accts data size delta in a block.

sections.heading: Detailed Design
paragraphs: Per the file, the following table shows (per the file) the current block limits (per the file) and future proposed block (per the file) limits: | Type | Current Block (per the file) Limit | SIMD-0256 Limit | SIMD-0286 (per the file) Limit | |------|-----|---------------|---------------------| | Max Block Units | 50M | 60M (per the file) | 100M | | Max Writable Account Units | 12M (per the file) | 12M | 12M | | Max Vote Units | 36M (per the file) | 36M | 36M | | Max Block Accounts Data (per the file) Size Delta | 100MB | 100MB | 100MB | The file advocates to set Max Writable Account (per the file) Units to 40% of Max Block Units.

Per the file, this will result in (per the file) the following Max Writable (per the file) Account Units for current (per the file) and future proposed Max (per the file) Block Units: | Block Limit (per the file) | Max Block Units | Max (per the file) Writable Account Units | | Current (per the file) | 50M | 20M | | SIMD-0256 | 60M (per the file) | 24M | | SIMD-0286 | 100M | 40M | The file only changes the Max Writable Account (per the file) Units limit. Per the file, the purpose is to (per the file) increase amount of activity (per the file) that can target a single acct.

Per the file, the Max Block Unit is left unchanged. Per the file, further increases to global limit is to be addressed with SIMD-0286. Per the file, increasing Max Writeable Account (per the file) Units while leaving Max (per the file) Block Units unchanged takes (per the file) advantage of underutilized serial execution capacity. Per the file, the intention is for (per the file) this to follow SIMD-0256 (per the file) but activate before SIMD-0286 (which (per the file) has not merged yet). Per the file, rationale is that we (per the file) are ready to handle (per the file) this increased serialized execution (per the file) today but the 100M (per the file) CU increase has some development dependencies. Per the file, that said, we is to be capable of handling (per the file) a scenario where SIMD-0286 (per the file) merges and gets activated first.
